notes: Documented singular hour replaces the field, including midnight; truthiness drops zero and the hour-17 holdout distinguishes it.
Pinned documentation equates unspecified weekday ordinal and +1; the holdout tests the exact left-None pair changed by mutation.
Public constructor relative normalization must carry sixty seconds to minute one; threshold mutation leaves sixty unnormalized.
Specific bytes salt is distinct from omitted None; empty salt must reach the first yielded signer instead of configured fallback.
derive_key documents a specific key override; none derivation preserves explicit empty bytes, whereas mutation substitutes secret.
HasHTML conversion and Markup documentation justify __html__ selection; different HTML and str representations isolate the branch.
Markup follows str unsupported integer addition: NotImplemented leads to TypeError; returning self silently loses the operand.
Markup string behavior selects a at index zero and preserves safety type; mutant selects b.
HTML format protocol rejects unsupported nonempty specifications; mutant accepts bad, and ValueError is the appropriate oracle.
Explicit separator with maxsplit zero leaves the entire string; mutant splits once. Equality oracle tests count, not element type.
DateTime and ParamType documentation require datetime output for already typed input; mutant returns ISO text.

STRING output must be str; controlled ASCII argv encoding makes byte ff enter fallback. Type-only oracle avoids prescribing replacement characters.
UUID parameter conversion must return UUID even for an already typed input; holdout checks type without identity assumptions.
xafter count is the maximum, None is unlimited; zero yields none. Finite three-date recurrence makes mutant detection terminate.
dictsort documents key/value selectors; invalid selector raises FilterArgumentError instead of silently sorting by key.
round documents common/ceil/floor; invalid method raises FilterArgumentError. Numeric input and precision isolate validation.
At length four with zero leeway the four-character string remains unchanged; mutant truncates it. Suffix preconditions hold.
sum accepts integer attribute selectors; index zero selects first tuple fields and sums to four, whereas mutant drops selection.
Markup.escape explicitly guarantees correct subclass output; mutation returns base Markup and exact Sub type detects it.
Markup corresponding methods and formatting docs promise escaped arguments and Markup output; holdout checks both.
Public wrap_text width is maximum width; simple long ASCII word at width one splits into four single-character lines.
Raw paragraph backspace marker and initial/subsequent indent are documented; second line must use S:, not I:.
Invalid one-character base64 cannot be a signature; verify_signature must reject decoding failure with False.
indent docstring skips first and blank lines by default; empty input stays empty rather than adding two spaces.
ParserError remains a ValueError subclass with successful str formatting fallback; mutation removes TypeError catch. Holdout does not prescribe exact text.
HMACAlgorithm documents HMAC generation; empty bytes differs from zero byte. Independent stdlib SHA256-HMAC is the oracle.
Signer signs the supplied empty value; independent HMAC and URL-safe encoding detects substituted zero byte without assuming message text.
fromutc preconditions explicitly require receiver tzinfo; mismatched identity yields ValueError before delegation, not TypeError.
Documented original_error retains the supplied diagnostic exception; identity check on a ValueError catches discarding it.
